samples: This program prints a one-line greeting to the console, using the first command-line argument as the name and falling back to "world" if none is given. It only needs permission to write to the console and read the environment (for the arguments), so it touches no files or network. It's a simple, safe hello-world that is useful as a starter or a check that your setup works, but it does nothing beyond greeting.
